title: Prayer
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Christians pray in different postures; all are taught as ways of showing respect to God, none as the only right one (FAITH).

skills.key_step: The child puts the Lord's Prayer in order, says Jesus taught it, and names respectful prayer postures.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the first lines of the Lord's Prayer.
floor.question: Say the first line of the Lord's Prayer.
floor.answer: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name

steps: Read the prayer from the chart.

board.do: Write the first and last lines with a gap.
Wait for the child to say the next line.

misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 6:9: "This, then, is how you should pray."

listen_for: Give us today our daily bread
misconceptions.ask: What are the first words of the Lord's Prayer?
misconceptions.repair: Use line cards on a washing line and put them in order.

misconceptions.ask: Is kneeling the only right way to pray?
misconceptions.repair: Show pictures of people praying in different postures. Ask what they share: respect.

misconceptions.ask: The class is praying. What should you do?
misconceptions.repair: Practise a short class prayer with a respectful posture.

checks.question: Name a respectful posture for prayer.
checks.answer: Kneeling (bowing the head, closing the eyes)
